<script language="javascript">
    var cmbcheckrel;
    var j;

    function show() {       
        var usercnt = document.getElementById('ctl00_cmbrellinks');

        //======================== For get the text field of Combo Box==================//

        var seltext;        
        var destList = document.getElementById('ctl00_cmbrellinks');
       
        var len = destList.options.length;
        for (var i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            if (destList.options[i].selected == true)
                seltext = destList.options[i].text;
        }
        //==================================================================================//
        if (usercnt.value != '0') {
            j = usercnt.value.split(',');
            var arrcnt = j[1];
            var arrCol = j[2].split(';');
            var k = arrcnt.split(';');
            var frmvalue = "";
            var rtn = true;
            var degflag = false;
            var arrcond = new Array("condcol1", "condcol2", "condcol3", "condcol4", "condcol5");

            for (var i = 0; i < k.length; i++) {
                var cnttype = k[i];
                // commented by sunil on 17 jan 2009
                cmbcheckrel = eval("document.getElementById('" + arrCol[i] + "')");
                if (cmbcheckrel != null) {
                    if (cnttype.toLowerCase() == 'combobox') {
                        if (cmbcheckrel.value == '0' || cmbcheckrel.value == '') {
                            alert('No information to display.');
                            rtn = false;
                        }
                        else {
                            frmvalue = frmvalue + arrcond[i] + "=" + cmbcheckrel.value + "&";
                        }
                    }
                    else if (cnttype.toLowerCase() == 'textbox') {
                        if (cmbcheckrel.value == '') {
                            alert('No information to display.');
                            rtn = false;
                        }
                        else
                            frmvalue = frmvalue + arrcond[i] + "=" + cmbcheckrel.value + "&";
                    }
                    else if (cnttype.toLowerCase() == 'comboboxtext') {
                        if (cmbcheckrel.value == '0' || cmbcheckrel.value == '') {
                            alert('No information to display.');
                            rtn = false;
                        }
                        else {
                            var cmbtxt = cmbcheckrel.options[cmbcheckrel.selectedIndex].text
                            frmvalue = frmvalue + arrcond[i] + "=" + cmbtxt + "&";
                        }

                    }
                    else if (cnttype.toLowerCase() == '360deg') //for 360 view
                    {
                        if (cmbcheckrel.value == '') {
                            alert('No information to display.');
                            rtn = false;
                        }
                        else {
                            frmvalue = frmvalue + arrcond[i] + "=" + cmbcheckrel.value + "&";
                            degflag = true;
                        }
                    }

                }
            }

            if (rtn) {
                frmvalue = frmvalue.slice(0, frmvalue.length - 1)
                if (j[4] == '0') {
                    showPopWin('../UserControl/ShowRelLinksitems.aspx?&ncode=' + j[0] + '&' + frmvalue + '&headertext=' + seltext, 800, 425, null, null, 'Related Links')
                    //window.open('../UserControl/ShowRelLinksitems.aspx?&ncode='+j[0]+'&'+frmvalue+'&headertext='+seltext,'item','top=0,left=0,height=515,width=490,resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes,status=no,addressbar=no');
                }
                else {
                    //showPopWin(('../UserControl/rptRelLinks.aspx?&ncode='+j[0]+'&'+frmvalue+'&headertext='+seltext,800,425,null,null,'Related Links')		
                    if (degflag == false)
                        window.open('../UserControl/rptRelLinks.aspx?&ncode=' + j[0] + '&' + frmvalue + '&headertext=' + seltext, 'item', 'top=0,left=0,height=515,width=490,resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes,status=no,addressbar=no');
                    else
                        window.open('../UserControl/rptRelLinks.aspx?&ncode=' + j[0] + '&' + frmvalue + '&headertext=' + seltext + '&degflag=' + cmbcheckrel.value + '', 'item', 'top=0,left=0,height=515,width=490,resizable=yes,scrollbars=yes,status=no,addressbar=no');
                }
            }
            else {
                //alert('Select an appropriate link.');
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
		
</script>

                                                                    <script language="Javascript">
                                                                        var ua = document.getElementById('dtrndate_TextBox');
                                                                        function subcall() {
                                                                            if (event.keyCode == 13) {
                                                                                event.returnValue = false;
                                                                                event.cancel = true;

                                                                    </script>
                                                                    <script language="Javascript">

                                                                        function k(i) {
                                                                            var keyCode = event.keyCode ? event.keyCode : event.which;
                                                                            var key = String.fromCharCode(keyCode);
                                                                            var re = new Array(/[a-zA-Z .]/, /[0-9]/, /['~`^"]/);
                                                                            i = (i < 0 || i >= re.length) ? 0 : i;
                                                                            if (re[i].test(key)) {
                                                                                alert('This key ' + key + ' is not allowed');
                                                                                return false;
                                                                            }
                                                                            else {
                                                                                event.keyCode = key.charCodeAt();
                                                                                return true;
                                                                            }
                                                                        } var ua = document.getElementById('dtrndate_TextBox');
                                                                        ua.onkeypress = new Function("return k(2)");
                                                                    </script>

    var sarrmudole = hrnmodule.split(','); for (i = 0; i <= sarrmudole.length; i++) { if (sarrmudole[i] != "") { try { var mat = document.getElementById(sarrmudole[i]).parentElement; mat.style.display = "block"; mat.style.visibility = "visibile"; } catch (e) { } } }
    var xmlhttp = null;
    var menuxmlhttp = null;
    function menuofficeonchange(vthis) {
        try { menuxmlhttp = new ActiveXObject("Msxml2.XMLHTTP"); }
        catch (e) {
            try { menuxmlhttp = new ActiveXObject("Microsoft.XMLHTTP"); }
            catch (e) {
                try { menuxmlhttp = new XMLHttpRequest(); }
                catch (e) { menuxmlhttp = false; }
            }
        }
        var myRand = parseInt(Math.random() * 999999999999999);
        var sURL = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.host + "/" + window.location.pathname.split('/')[1] + "/UserControl/changeoffice.aspx?officeid=" + vthis.value + "&officename=" + vthis.options[vthis.selectedIndex].text + "&rand=" + myRand;
        menuxmlhttp.open("GET", sURL, true);
        menuxmlhttp.setRequestHeader("Method", "POST " + sURL + " HTTP/1.1");
        menuxmlhttp.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded");
        menuxmlhttp.onreadystatechange = menuchangestatus
        menuxmlhttp.send(null);
    }
    function menuchangestatus() {

        if (menuxmlhttp.readyState == 4 || menuxmlhttp.readyState == "complete") {
            window.location.href = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.host + "/" + window.location.pathname.split('/')[1] + "/home_main.aspx"
        }
        //else{alert("Internal Sever Error.");return null;}
    }    
</script>

    function loadactivity() {
                    $('#ddlactivity').prop("disabled", true);
                  clearControl();

            fillddl('Getshactivity&module=' + $("#ddlmodule :selected").text(), $('#ddlactivity'), ' Select Topic ');
            $('#ddlactivity').empty().append('<option selected="selected" value="0">Not Available</option>');

       {

            $('#ddlactivity').prop("disabled", true);
       }
       
        return false;

    function fillddl(section, control, indexText, nextFunc) {
        $.ajax({
            type: "GET",
            url: "/WRL/WebServices/AutoSearch.ashx/GetAutoCompleteData",
            // data: '{continentId: ' + $('#ctl00_ContentPlaceHolder1_ddltype').val() + '}',
            data: 'Section=' + section + '',
            contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
            dataType: "json",
            success: function (result) {
                MasterPopulateDDL(result, control, indexText);
                
                //if (nextFunc != null)
                //  fillddl(section, control, indexText);
            },
            failure: function (response) {
                alert(response.d);
            }
        });
    }

    function clearControl()
    {
        $("#lblmenu").prop("innerHTML","");
        $("#lblrem").prop("innerHTML","");
        $("#lblsteps").prop("innerHTML","");
    }

    function MasterPopulateDDL(list, control, indexText) {
        if (list.length > 0) {
            control.removeAttr("disabled");
            control.empty().append('<option selected="selected" value="0">--' + indexText + '--</option>');
            $.each(list, function () {
                var val1 = this.split('~')[1];
                var val2 = this.split('~')[0];

                control.append($('<option></option>').val(val2).html(val1));
                
            });
        }
        else {
            control.empty().append('<option selected="selected" value="">Not available<option>');
        }
    }


    function AutoFilliwant() {
         var fn = "";
         
        $("#txtwant").autocomplete({
            minLength: 2, 
            close: function (event, ui) {
                if(detectmob()==true)
                $("#ddlmodule").focus();
              },

            source: function (request, response) {
                /*START: CONDITION-CRITERIA SECTION*/
                var criteria = "";
               

                $.ajax({
                    type: "GET",
                    url: "/WRL/WebServices/AutoSearch.ashx/GetAutoCompleteData",
                    data: 'Section=Getshiwant&iwant=' + $("#txtwant").val(),
                    dataType: "json",
                    success: function (data) {
                        if (data.length > 0) {
                            var mydate = data;
                            response($.map(data, function (item) {
                                return {
                                    label: item.split('~')[1],
                                   val: item.split('~')[0],
                                   labelvrem:item.split('~')[2],
                                   labelvmenu:item.split('~')[3],
                                   labelvsteps:item.split('~')[4],
                                }
                            }));
                        }
                        else {
                            response([{ label: 'No results found.', val: -1}]);
                        }
                    },
                    error: function (result) {
                        alert("Error");
                    }
                });
            },
            select: function (event, ui) {
                if (ui.item.val == -1) {
                  
                    return false;
                }
                else {
                    
                    clearControl();
                    if(detectmob()==true)
                    {
                       $("#divdata")[0].style.height=300;
                       $("#divdata")[0].style.width=220;
                       
                    }

                    $("#lblmenu").prop("innerHTML",ui.item.labelvmenu);
                    $("#lblrem").prop("innerHTML",ui.item.labelvrem);
                    $("#lblsteps").prop("innerHTML",ui.item.labelvsteps);
                    
                    $(this).val("");
                    return false;
                }
            }
           
        })

        $("#txtwant").autocomplete().data("ui-autocomplete")._renderItem =  function( ul, item ) 
        {
        
         return $( "<li>" )
         .append( "<a>" +item.label + "</a>" )
         .appendTo( ul );
       };
    }

    function loadhelp()
    {
        
        if ($('#ddlmodule').prop('selectedIndex') > 0 && $('#ddlactivity').prop('selectedIndex') > 0) {
            clearControl();
            var val= $('#ddlactivity').val().split('^');
                    $("#lblmenu").prop("innerHTML",val[3]);
                    $("#lblrem").prop("innerHTML",val[2]);
                    $("#lblsteps").prop("innerHTML",val[4]);
                    
                    //$("#divdata")[0].style.height=($("#divdata")[0].scrollHeight-($("#divdata")[0].scrollHeight * 10)/100);
                    if(detectmob()==true)
                    {
                       $("#divdata")[0].style.height=300;
                       $("#divdata")[0].style.width=220;
                    }
        }
        return false;
    }

        function detectmob() {
            if (navigator.userAgent.match(/Android/i) || navigator.userAgent.match(/webOS/i) || navigator.userAgent.match(/iPhone/i) || navigator.userAgent.match(/iPad/i) || navigator.userAgent.match(/iPod/i) || navigator.userAgent.match(/BlackBerry/i) || navigator.userAgent.match(/Windows Phone/i)) {
                return true;
            }
            else {
                return false;
            }
        }

    function fillcmbfiled() {
        $('#ctl00_cmbfiled').empty().append('<option selected="selected" value="0">Select</option>');
        $('#ctl00_qsearch').val("");

        //$('#ctl00_cmbfiled').empty().append('<option selected="selected" value="0">Loading...</option>');

                alert(response.d);
            }
        });

    function OnModuleChange(response) {
        PopulateControl1(response, $("#ctl00_cmbfiled"));

    function PopulateControl1(list, control) {
        if (list.length > 0) {
            control.removeAttr("disabled");
            $.each(list, function () {
                var val1 = this.split('~')[1];
                var val2 = this.split('~')[0];
                var n = val1.toLowerCase().indexOf("fromdate");
                if (parseInt(n) == -1) {
                    control.append($('<option></option>').val(val1).html(val2));
                }
                else {
                    //control.append($('<option></option>').val(this.split('/')[1]).html(this.split('/')[0]));                    
                    control.append($('<option selected="selected"></option>').val(val1).html(val2));
                    fquicksearch();
                }
            });
        }
        else {
            control.empty().append('<option selected="selected" value="">Not available<option>');
        }
    }

    function fquicksearch() {
        $('#ctl00_qsearch').val("");
        var str = $('#ctl00_cmbfiled :selected').val();
        var array_str = $('#ctl00_cmbfiled :selected').val().split(':');
        var str1 = array_str[1];
        if (str1.toLowerCase() == "datetime") {
            $('#ctl00_qsearch').css('display', 'none');
            $('div#dt_picker').css('display', '');
        }
        else {
            $('#ctl00_qsearch').css('display', '');
            $('div#dt_picker').css('display', 'none');
        }

        if (str.toLowerCase().indexOf("fromdate") >= 0) {

            $.ajax({
                type: "GET",
                url: "/WRL/WebServices/AutoSearch.ashx/GetAutoCompleteData",
                data: 'Section=Getqsearch&moduleid=' + $('#ctl00_cmbmodule :selected').val(),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",

                success: Oncmbfiled,
                failure: function (response) {
                    alert(response.d);
                }
            });
        }
    }

        if (response.length > 0) {
            $.each(response, function () {
                $('input#dtqsearch').val(this.split('~')[1]);

            });
        }
    }

    function loc_navigate() {
        var pagenm = $('#ctl00_cmbfiled :selected').val();
        var array_filedval = $('#ctl00_cmbfiled :selected').val().split(':');
        pagenm = "/" + array_filedval[2];
        var datatype = array_filedval[1];
        var ttype = "";
        var qsearch = "";

        if (datatype.toLowerCase() == "datetime") {
            qsearch = $('input#dtqsearch').val();
            ttype = "D";
        }
        else {
            qsearch = $('#ctl00_qsearch').val();
            ttype = "N";
        }

        var qsearch1 = $('#ctl00_cmbfiled')[0].selectedIndex;

        document.cookie = 'Text1=;expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:01 GMT;';
        if ($('#ctl00_cmbfiled :selected').val() != null && $('#ctl00_cmbfiled :selected').val() != '0') {
            document.cookie = 'Text1=txt1=:&ddl1=';
            document.cookie = 'Text1=txt1=' + array_filedval[0] + ':' + qsearch + '&ddl1=';

            $.ajax({
                type: "GET",
                url: "/WRL/WebServices/AutoSearch.ashx/GetAutoCompleteData",
                data: 'Section=setsearchheading&heading=' + $('#ctl00_cmbmodule :selected').text(),
                contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
                dataType: "json",
                success: function (data) {
                    //var path = "/WRL" + pagenm + "?q=qsearch&qsearchval=" + qsearch + "@" + ttype + "@" + qsearch1 + "";
                    //var path = "/WRL" + pagenm + "?q=qsearch&qsearchval=" + qsearch + "@" + ttype + "@" + qsearch1 + "&qsearchval1="+qsearch+"&qserchfld="+array_filedval[0];
                    var path = "/WRL" + pagenm + "?q=qsearch&qsearchval="+qsearch+"&header=YES&search=YES&qserchfld="+array_filedval[0];
                    window.location.assign(path);
                },
                failure: function (response) {
                    alert(response.d);
                }
            });
        }
        //alert(document.cookie);
    }


    function getCookie(cname) {
        var name = cname + "=";
        var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
        for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
            var c = ca[i];
            while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') c = c.substring(1);
            if (c.indexOf(name) == 0) {
                return c.substring(name.length, c.length);
            }
        }
        return "";
    }

    function deleteCookie(c_name) {
        document.cookie = encodeURIComponent(c_name) + "=deleted; expires=" + new Date(0).toUTCString();
    }
</script>

        function send_UserRequext(obj, type) {

            if (obj.checked) {
                stype = type;
                var lstdesg
                if (type == 'desg')
                    lstdesg = document.getElementById("lstusrdesg");
                else
                    lstdesg = document.getElementById("lstusers");
                var desgids = "";

                for (i = 0; i < lstdesg.length; i++) {
                    if (lstdesg.options[i].selected)
                        desgids = desgids + lstdesg.options[i].value + ',';
                }
                //var desktype = document.getElementById("ddldashtype")
                desgids = desgids.slice(0, desgids.length - 1);
                xmlHttp = GetXmlHttpObject();
                var sURL = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.host + "/" + window.location.pathname.split('/')[1] + "/UserControl/changeoffice.aspx?desktype=" + 2 + "&module=" + type + "&ncode=" + desgids;
                xmlHttp.open("GET", sURL, true);
                xmlHttp.setRequestHeader("Method", "POST " + sURL + " HTTP/1.1");
                xmlHttp.setRequestHeader("Content-Type", "application/x-www-form-urlencoded");
                xmlHttp.onreadystatechange = changestatus
                xmlHttp.send(null);
            }
        }
        function changestatus() {
            if (xmlHttp.readyState == 4 || xmlHttp.readyState == "complete") {
                rtn = xmlHttp.responseText.split("<")[0];
                rtn = rtn.split(",")
                filldesg();
            }
        }

        function filldesg() {
            if (stype == 'desg') {
                var lstdesg = document.getElementById("lstusrdesg");
                for (j = 0; j < rtn.length; j++) {
                    for (i = 0; i < lstdesg.length; i++) {
                        if (lstdesg.options[i].value == rtn[j]) {
                            lstdesg.options[i].selected = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                SelectAll();
                document.getElementById("chku2").checked = true;
            }
            else {
                var lstuser = document.getElementById("lstusers");
                for (j = 0; j < rtn.length; j++) {
                    for (i = 0; i < lstuser.length; i++) {
                        if (lstuser.options[i].value == rtn[j]) {
                            lstuser.options[i].selected = true;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                }

                selectuser(lstuser);

                document.getElementById("chku2").checked = true;
            }
        }

            var arrhdnuser = document.getElementById("hdnoffid").value.split(",");



            for (i = 0; i < obj.length; i++) {

                    countuser++;
                    seluser = obj.options[i].text;
                    for (j = 0; j < arrhdnuser.length; j = j + 2) {
                        if (obj.options[i].value == arrhdnuser[j]) {
                            for (k = 0; k < lstdesg.length; k++) {
                                if (arrhdnuser[j + 1] == lstdesg.options[k].value) {
                                    if (lstdesg.options[k].selected == false) {
                                        countdesg++;

                                    }
                                    lstdesg.options[k].selected = true;

                                }
                            }

            //            }
        }

        function validatefrmtodate() {

        function search() {

            var lstuser = document.getElementById("lstusers");
            var lstdesg = document.getElementById("lstusrdesg");

            var selusers = "", selecteddesg = "";
            for (i = 0; i < lstuser.length; i++) {
                if (lstuser.options[i].selected)
                    selusers = selusers + Math.abs(lstuser.options[i].value) + ",";
            }
            selusers = selusers.slice(0, selusers.length - 1);

            for (i = 0; i < lstdesg.length; i++) {
                if (lstdesg.options[i].selected)
                    selecteddesg = selecteddesg + Math.abs(lstdesg.options[i].value) + ",";
            }

            //selusers = selusers.slice(0, selusers.length - 1);
            selecteddesg = selecteddesg.slice(0, selecteddesg.length - 1);

            document.getElementById("selecteduser").value = selusers;
            document.getElementById("selecteddesg").value = selecteddesg;


        }

        $(document).ready(function () {

                            });

            function show_position(p) {
                hfsource.value = p.coords.latitude + ',' + p.coords.longitude;
            }

        });
        function GetParameterValues(param) {

            var url = window.location.href.slice(window.location.href.indexOf('?') + 1).split('&');
            var ret = [];
            for (var i = 0; i < url.length; i++) {
                var urlparam = url[i].split('=');
                var newarr = {}
                newarr["name"] = urlparam[0];
                newarr["value"] = urlparam[1];
                ret.push(newarr);
            }
            return ret;
        }
        var latlongdest, latlongsource;
        function fn(childNodes1, childNodes3) {
            latlongdest = childNodes1;
            latlongsource = document.getElementById('hfsourcelatlong').value;
            if (latlongdest.length > 0) {
                if (latlongsource.length > 0) {
                    window.open("https://www.google.co.in/maps/dir/'" + latlongsource + "'/'" + latlongdest + "'");
                }
                else {
                    alert('Could not get current location !');
                }
            }
            else {
                if (childNodes3.length > 3) {
                    codeAddress(childNodes3);
                }
                else {
                    alert('Geocode was not successful for the following reason: Invalid Address !');
                }
            }
            return false;
        }
        function codeAddress(addressVal) {
            geocoder = new google.maps.Geocoder();
            geocoder.geocode({ 'address': addressVal }, function (results, status) {
                if (status == google.maps.GeocoderStatus.OK) {
                    ret = results[0].geometry.location.lat() + ',' + results[0].geometry.location.lng();
                    window.open("https://www.google.co.in/maps/dir/'" + latlongsource + "'/'" + ret + "'");
                } else {
                    alert('Geocode was not successful for the following reason: Invalid Address ! ' + status);
                }
            });
            return false;
        }

            // ClearEntryPanel();
            var searchqueryfilename = document.getElementById('ddlsavedquery').value;
            //  alert(searchqueryfilename);
            var controlvaluessplit = strtokens = searchqueryfilename.split('~');
            if (controlvaluessplit != "") {
                for (var i = 0; i < controlvaluessplit.length; i++) {
                    var controlvaluessplit1 = controlvaluessplit[i].split('=');
                    var control = controlvaluessplit1[0];
                    //    alert(control);
                    document.getElementById(control).value = controlvaluessplit1[1];

                    if (control == "selecteddesg") {
                        if (document.getElementById("selecteddesg").value != "") {
                            document.getElementById("lstusrdesg").value = document.getElementById("selecteddesg").value;
                            SelectAll();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

            var tbl = document.getElementById('findpanel_thePanel');
            //tbl.className = "backcls";
            tbl.width = "100%";
            //            tbl.deleteRow(0)
            //            tbl.removeAttribute("style");
            //            tbl.style.marginLeft = '6px';
            var tr = tbl.rows[0];
            tr.deleteCell(1);
            var td = tr.cells[0];
            //td.style.text-align='center';
            td.style.textAlign = 'center';
            td.style.height = '30px';

        }

            document.getElementById('lblpen').innerHTML = "&nbsp;";
            document.getElementById('lblent').innerHTML = "&nbsp;";
        }
    }

        //alert(cal);

                cal.hide();
                displaySelectBoxesdate();
            }
        }
    }
